acceptance: After `make pr-preflight`, the selected test files can be read from its output or from a file whose path it prints, without re-running anything.
A unit test of the receipt or the listing step shows a known mapped file appears for a changed source path.
`make pr-open` accepts a receipt produced after the change, shown once on a real branch.
context: 2026-11-13: gate result: the receipt recorded only counts, so the selected names are now recorded as a top-level `test_file_names` field and the 'tests for changed files' line prints the count plus the names (20 or fewer) or the receipt path. Receipt schema stays 2; `verify_receipt` reads only the `selection` integers, and a test confirms a receipt without the field is accepted. Branch fix/landing-tooling-noise, commit e0a4a56c5e. Known limit: if the new `tests` subcommand fails, the line prints without the summary and preflight continues, so the names would be missing from that receipt.
description:
`make pr-preflight` builds the list of test files mapped to the changed paths, then runs `pytest -q -n 0 --tb=short --ff $(cat "$TEST_LIST")` and deletes the temporary list. With `-q` the output is dots and a count ('156 passed, 1 skipped'), so neither the log nor the terminal says which files ran. On 2026-11-12 an item required `tests/unit/scripts/test_batch_integration.py` to pass; the preflight log could not show whether it was among the 156, and the file was run again by hand (4.5 minutes) to be sure. A reviewer reading a pull request's 'pr-preflight passed' line has the same blind spot, and so does anyone diagnosing why a mapped test was missed (compare preflight-misses-source-scanning-guard-tests-20261112).

Decision gate. Check first whether the preflight receipt (`scripts/preflight_receipt.py`, written under `~/.cache/benchbox/preflight/`) already records the selected files. If it does, the fix is to print its path and a one-line count per directory; if it does not, decide between printing the list before the run and recording it in the receipt. Do not do both without a reason.

Guardrails.
- Selection itself does not change: same files, same order, same pytest flags.
- No raw log is committed, and the receipt format changes only in a way `make pr-open` still accepts (it requires a passing receipt for the pushed tree).
- Output stays short for large changes: print a count and the receipt path when the list is long.
